name: faster-whisper

MODEL_NAME.description: CTranslate2 Whisper model to load (e.g. tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3, distil-large-v3). Defaults to large-v3.

DEVICE.description: Compute device: 'cpu', 'cuda', or 'auto'. Defaults to auto.

COMPUTE_TYPE.description: Quantisation: 'int8', 'int8_float16', 'float16', 'float32'. Defaults to int8 on CPU, float16 on CUDA.

MODEL_CACHE_DIR.description: Override the HuggingFace cache dir for model downloads.

notes: Local Whisper inference (CTranslate2). Pure read-only over audio files — no network, no shell. Tier EXECUTOR with low trust floor since the only side effects are returning text and writing transcript files into a sandboxed output dir.
